source: Nikon press release: Nikon Launches DSP-110 Digital Lithography System with 1.5 (10-13-2026)

players.product: ArF immersion, ArF dry, KrF and i-line semiconductor lithography systems (NSR series), FPD lithography systems and digital lithography systems for advanced packaging

quarterly_data.signal: Product launch (advanced packaging): Nikon will release the DSP-110 digital lithography system for semiconductor advanced packaging (maskless, for RDL patterning on large interposers and multilayer FC-BGA substrates) in April 2027, with 1.5 um L/S resolution, i-line-equivalent light source, overlay accuracy <=+/-0.3 um and throughput of 72 panels/hour on 510 x 515 mm substrates, approximately 40% higher than the DSP-100 (1.0 um L/S); it supports square substrates up to 730 x 920 mm and 300 mm wafers and can be upgraded to 1.0 um L/S by replacing its optical system.
quarterly_data.figure: release April 2027; 1.5 um L/S; 72 panels/hour; approximately 40% higher throughput than DSP-100
